text:
alex: Heads-up: planning to roll a Private/VPC installer v1.4.1 canary tonight in the 21:00-21:30 UTC window. Need final packaging sign-off, cosign sigs, and mirror seeding confirmation.
deploy-bot: Canary job created for 2026-03-21T21:15Z (30m window). Preflight at T-45m, publish at T-20m. Will abort on publish failures.
tay: Suggested rollback triggers: sustained error rate >8% for 3m OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 5m OR cosign verification failure on any node. Anyone object?
morgan: +1 to those. Also add: missing transport manifest entry or missing digest on mirror -> immediate abort.
package-bot: Preflight check summary:
```
ok  archive checksum: sha256:abc123def
ok  shrinkwrap present: s3://artifacts/private/v1.4.1/shrinkwrap.json
warn delta: gzip +18% (within safety threshold)
ok  cosign signatures: signer=theo, signer-bot verified
```
theo: I pushed my cosign sig at 2026-03-21T20:40Z. cosign:sha256:1f2e3d4c. KMS policy checked: deploy-service has decrypt/unwrap scope for key `projects/redwood/keys/private-deploy`.
signer-bot: Signature verification: all signatures validated across mirrors. KMS unwrap test: OK.
alex: Ops - confirm that replicate pushes made it to offline mirrors (ny, eu) and the airgap courier ETA?
ops: Mirrors show `push OK` at 2026-03-21T20:47Z. Artifact digest `sha256:abc123def`. Airgap courier ETA 2026-03-22T02:00Z UTC (estimated). Chain-of-custody doc: https://internal.re/redwood/airgap/1.4.1
tay: Rolling back plan draft:
- alias swap: set `private/latest` -> `v1.3.10`
- mark `v1.4.1` deprecated in index (do not delete, set deprecated flag)
- run transport backfill for mirrors if needed
- broadcast to private-customers channel + open incident if any customer-facing errors
Example commands:
```bash
redwood-index set-alias private/latest v1.3.10
redwood-index deprecate private v1.4.1 --reason "canary-failure"
```
morgan: Add an emergency fast-path: if cosign mismatch occurs after publish, we should immediately flip clients using alias and trigger mirror purge request.
alex: Agreed. Also policy: we will not rollback for minor telemetry blips under 1 minute; must meet sustained thresholds.
package-bot: Packaging dry-run results: all artifacts compiled, shrinkwrap sealed, cosign attached. Publish dry-run OK.
deploy-bot: Dry-run OK. Live deploy will run the following steps: (1) publish index entry (2) replicate to mirrors (3) notify transport service to seed airgap bundle. Automatic abort on step failure.
theo: Signer queue cleared. KMS unwrap tested with deploy service account.
ops: Mirror transport logs: replicator job id r-7921 success to mirror-ny and mirror-eu. No missing layers.
alex: Final call: proceed with canary at T-20m? If so I'll kick the window and monitor. :eyes:
tay: Proceed from me. I'll watch metrics and be ready to execute rollback steps.
morgan: LGTM. I'll standby for any signing or manifest issues.
alex: Kicking at T-20m. Will post status updates here. If rollback triggered, runbook is in incidents channel and I'll paste steps.
package-bot: Publish step started at 2026-03-21T21:00:00Z.
deploy-bot: Publish completed, mirrors notified, canary routing enabled for 2% traffic. Monitoring p95 and error-rate streams.
tay: Monitoring: p95 x1.1 baseline, errors 0.5% -> continuing.
ops: Transport record: airgap bundle assembled, courier manifest created.
alex: Canary green at 10m. Increasing to 10% traffic per rollout policy.
tay: Still good. No signs of cosign mismatch or missing digest.
deploy-bot: Canary complete at T+20m with no abort triggers. Will proceed to standard rollout per schedule.
alex: Thanks all. Saving notes: version=v1.4.1, digest=sha256:abc123def, cosign=sha256:1f2e3d4c, mirrors=[ny,eu], courier=2026-03-22T02:00Z. Playbook pinned in incidents if needed.
